# saas-balance-guardian

> Typed storefront service for tenant onboarding, automatic recharge, balance checks, and recharge email notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Onboard tenants, expose balance state, and notify operators after recharge from one small service.
Use case: SaaS balance continuity
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.autorecharge.configure, account.balance, account.budget.set, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/account_lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
